pages.title: Home - American School of Dubai
blocks: The American School of Dubai is an independent, not-for-profit, U.S. curriculum, PreK-12 international school that provides learning experiences designed to promote the maximum potential of its students.
Established in 1966, prior to the founding of the UAE, ASD takes pride in its enduring traditions and a legacy alumni community that spans generations and continents.
The Early Learning Center is an on-campus, purpose-built, flexible learning environment for PreK, K1, and K2 students.
In Elementary School, students develop curiosity and confidence through a balanced program that blends hands-on discovery with intentional structure.
The Middle School cultivates academic growth and curiosity while encouraging students to explore their evolving interests.
The High School nurtures well-rounded learners who engage in thoughtful inquiry, take ownership of their learning, and graduate as reflective thinkers ready for higher education and beyond.

Community is the Heartbeat of ASD. It is felt in every classroom, across stages and sidelines, and through the lasting connections shared by Falcons past and present. From spirited student leaders and engaged parents to dedicated employees and proud alumni, our community thrives on connection, collaboration, and shared purpose.

When Adrienne Gerst stepped into the choir room at ASD well over a decade ago, she brought with her years of experience and a deep love for choral music. What she didn’t expect was how profoundly the move from small-town Iowa to the heart of Dubai would shape her life, both on and off the podium.

For Grade 10 student Maana ‘27, fashion goes beyond style. It is a form of storytelling, a canvas for creativity, and a platform for sustainability. Recently, her passion for both art and science came together in a powerful way through her entry in the 2025 Junk Kouture competition, where she designed and constructed a dress entirely from recycled materials.

FALL CLASSIC 2026 🏐 What an afternoon in the Field House! Our Varsity Girls and Boys Volleyball teams took on DAA in the annual Battle of Barsha, with both teams coming away with a win! 🏐 Varsity Girls: 4–1 🏐 Varsity Boys: 5–0 A huge thank you to our High School community for filling the stands, bringing the energy, and cheering on our Falcons throughout the afternoon. Great volleyball, great school spirit, and another memorable Fall Classic! Go Falcons! #ASDubai #ASDAthletics #FallClassic2026

What skills will employers actually pay for? That was a hot topic at last week’s #edufairdubai, and our very own Dr. Kulangara Jacob Johnson, Director of the Center for Design & Innovation for Public Purpose, joined the convo on what the future workforce really needs. Spoiler alert: Your CV is not the whole vibe!

Sí, oui, sì! These students said yes to excellence in more ways than one. Congratulations to our talented students who have earned the Global Seal of Biliteracy in French, Spanish, or Italian! #asdubai

pages.title: Mission & Values - American School of Dubai
blocks: ASD is an independent, not-for-profit international school offering a U.S. curriculum for students in PreK-12. We are dedicated to creating meaningful learning experiences that empower every student to grow, thrive, and reach their full potential.
To challenge and inspire each student to achieve their dreams and to become a passionate learner prepared to adapt and contribute in a rapidly changing world.

The American School of Dubai community is committed to fostering a safe and inclusive school climate and learning environment while denouncing all forms of discrimination and inequality. ASD values diversity. We celebrate all community members. We acknowledge the impact of current and historical inequality and prejudice, and firmly believe that fair treatment and equity are the most basic of rights regardless of gender, race, ethnicity, religion, color, culture, national origin, age, identity or expression, ability/disability, or socioeconomic status.
The ASD Rosette is based on a traditional Arabic geometric pattern that symbolizes unity and connection.

pages.title: About - American School of Dubai
blocks: Since 1966, the American School of Dubai has been a place where curiosity is nurtured, potential is unlocked, and community matters. Set on a world-class campus in the heart of a rapidly evolving city, ASD brings together outstanding educators, innovative learning spaces, and a shared commitment to student growth. Anchored by our mission to challenge and inspire every learner to thrive in a changing world, we are honored to be recognized for academic excellence, sustainability leadership, and a purpose-driven workplace culture.
ASD has a rich history that dates back to the very early years of Dubai. The school has grown from a small group of students to a thriving school community of more than 2,000 learners.

Located in the heart of Dubai, the campus features the Center for Design and Innovation, two libraries, and a diverse range of world-class facilities designed to support academic, artistic, and athletic excellence.
The mission of ASD is to challenge and inspire each student to achieve their dreams and to become a passionate learner prepared to adapt and contribute in a rapidly changing world.

ASD is recognized for its commitment to excellence in academic achievement, sustainability, and workplace culture. Guided by this commitment, our school pursues respected accreditations and meaningful partnerships with local, regional, and international organizations to inspire student success, advance professional learning, and strengthen global community connections.
